messages:
Priya: Quick catch-up after the postmortem. We need owners, timelines, and a lightweight verification plan for the GPU capacity remediations. I sketched a proposal below.

Evan: Sounds good. Paste the proposal?

Priya: Proposal: three parallel tracks -> quota request (cloud), scheduler experiments, formal headroom + smoke tests. Owners: Evan (quota), Nora (scheduler), Suresh (headroom). Quick targets: plan in 72h, staging canaries in 1 sprint, rollout in sprint 2.

Nora: For scheduler experiments I want a short test matrix: bin-packing changes, preemption threshold, and backfill window. Canary in staging with 10% load.

Suresh: Headroom: define static minimum per-region plus a dynamic percentile (95th) cushion. Add alert when sustained request rate approaches 85% of headroom for >10m.

Evan: I'll open the quota ticket today with requested increases and cost delta. If cloud lead time >2w we ask Ops-Lead for temporary burst pool.

Ops-Lead: Got it. I'll surface current reserved pools and any pending approvals. If quota is slow we can schedule burst for a week while longer request is processed.

Priya: Action items: Evan -> ticket + cost note; Nora -> test plan + staging PR; Suresh -> headroom doc + alert rules; Ops-Lead -> reserved pool audit. Add items to remediation board.

SRE-Bot: Action items added to remediation board: RB-3347. Reminder: 72h checkpoint scheduled.

Nora: Added initial scheduler test checklist: https://git.internal/scheduler/tests/PR-9. Canary config included.

Suresh: Headroom draft uploaded: https://docs.internal/headroom/draft-2026. Will add dashboard and 95th/sustained rule.

Evan: Ticket created: https://tickets.internal/INC-5533 assigned to cloud-quotas. Cost center noted.

Priya: Good progress. Reminder: recurring pattern — this is the third similar surge in 6 months. We need a 30-day regression check after rollout: synthetic 2x traffic smoke test and autoscale validation.

Ops-Lead: I'll schedule the smoke test job after rollout and share reserved pool changes.

Priya: Quick timeline recap: T0: tickets + audit; +72h: owners present concrete plan; sprint1: staging canaries & alerts; sprint2: rollout + regression check. Meeting tomorrow 10:30 to confirm plans.

Evan: I'll be there. Marking quota ticket created.

SRE-Bot: Reminder set: 2275013600 "GPU owners 72h checkpoint" by Priya.

Priya: Thanks all. Post any blockers here or DM me. :thumbsup:
